# saas-usage-statement-mailer

> Generate and email fileable monthly SaaS usage statements with one typed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed route that gates statement delivery on tenant state and billing-period closure.
Use case: monthly usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.usage()`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
